readme:
# GPipe 填充排空与微批次梯度

## 1. 问题

实现填充排空事件表，以及保持整批均值梯度的微批次损失。

等时分段、同步更新的 CPU 调度模型与线性回归；不模拟通信、BatchNorm或重计算。

原文: [GPipe: Efficient Training of Giant Neural Networks using Pipeline Parallelism](https://arxiv.org/abs/1811.06965) · Section 2.2, Algorithm; Figure 2, synchronous microbatch pipeline.

## 2. 核心公式

$$
F_{s,m}=s+m,\quad B_{s,m}=K+M-1+(K-1-s)+(M-1-m),\quad L=\frac{1}{N}\sum_c\sum_{i\in c}(x_i^T w-y_i)^2.
$$

## 3. 公式到代码

- `pipeline_schedule(stages: int, microbatches: int) -> list[tuple]` — Unit-duration forward/backward event records.
- `microbatch_mse(x: Tensor, y: Tensor, weight: Tensor, chunk_size: int) -> Tensor` — Differentiable scalar sample-mean squared error.

前向依赖来自左侧分段与同段前一微批次；反向从最后分段和最后微批次排空。累计每块平方误差之和，最后按样本数归约，不能平均各块均值。

## 4. 本题约定

stages、microbatches 和 chunk_size 为正整数。事件为 (phase, stage, microbatch, start)，phase 为 F/B；单事件占一个时隙。先完成所有前向，再按逆微批次顺序反向。x 为 (N,D)、y 为 (N,)、w 为 (D,)，允许最后一块较短；总损失除以 N。

## 5. 交互图

用 11 个确定性样本、4 维线性模型、学习率 0.08 的 35 步 SGD，对比整批和大小 4 的微批次轨迹；同时计算 4 分段在不同微批次数下的有效时隙率。

T3 使用实际待测函数生成实验，网页参考图使用参考实现。数值来自教学样本，不表示GPU吞吐或完整模型质量。

## 6. 在网页中运行

在右侧 Python 编辑器中补全实现，点击 **运行测试**。查看失败测试的原因、期望值与实际值，修改代码后再次运行。所有必要测试通过后，题目会标记为已完成并解锁坑点讲解。

## 7. 延伸

结合所引章节，解释本题保留了哪些维度、状态或调度约束，再扩展实验样本并保持已有契约。更大模型、真实设备与通信代价需要单独测量。

en.readme:
# GPipe Fill-Drain Scheduling and Microbatch Gradients

## 1. Problem

Build fill-drain events and preserve full-batch mean gradients under microbatching.

A CPU model of equal-duration stages and synchronous updates, with linear regression; communication, BatchNorm and rematerialization are outside this kernel.

Source: [GPipe: Efficient Training of Giant Neural Networks using Pipeline Parallelism](https://arxiv.org/abs/1811.06965) · Section 2.2, Algorithm; Figure 2, synchronous microbatch pipeline.

## 2. Core equations

$$
F_{s,m}=s+m,\quad B_{s,m}=K+M-1+(K-1-s)+(M-1-m),\quad L=\frac{1}{N}\sum_c\sum_{i\in c}(x_i^T w-y_i)^2.
$$

## 3. From equations to code

- `pipeline_schedule(stages: int, microbatches: int) -> list[tuple]` — Unit-duration forward/backward event records.
- `microbatch_mse(x: Tensor, y: Tensor, weight: Tensor, chunk_size: int) -> Tensor` — Differentiable scalar sample-mean squared error.

Forward work follows the preceding stage and microbatch; backward work drains from the last stage and microbatch. Accumulate sums of squared error, then divide by the sample count, rather than averaging chunk means.

## 4. Conventions

stages, microbatches and chunk_size are positive integers. Events are (phase, stage, microbatch, start), with phase F/B and unit duration. All forward events finish before reverse-order backward events. x is (N,D), y (N,), w (D,); a short final chunk is allowed. Divide total squared error by N.

## 5. Experiment view

Train a four-feature linear model on 11 deterministic samples for 35 SGD steps at learning rate 0.08; compare full-batch and size-four chunks. Also compute useful-slot fractions for four stages as microbatch count varies.

The chart is generated by the actual submitted kernel during T3 and by the reference during export. Values are synthetic teaching measurements, not GPU throughput or full-model quality claims.

## 6. Run your implementation

Complete the functions in the Python editor on the right, then click **Run tests**. Inspect each failed check, update your implementation, and run again. Passing every required check marks the problem as solved and unlocks the notes.

## 7. Further study

Read the cited section and explain which dimensions or scheduling constraints the kernel preserves. Then extend the experiment beyond the stated fixture while retaining the existing contract. Larger models, real devices, and communication costs require separate measurement.

# GPipe Fill-Drain Scheduling and Microbatch Gradients — Solution notes

## Derivation and implementation

Forward work follows the preceding stage and microbatch; backward work drains from the last stage and microbatch. Accumulate sums of squared error, then divide by the sample count, rather than averaging chunk means.

$$
F_{s,m}=s+m,\quad B_{s,m}=K+M-1+(K-1-s)+(M-1-m),\quad L=\frac{1}{N}\sum_c\sum_{i\in c}(x_i^T w-y_i)^2.
$$

## Boundary and gradient ownership

stages, microbatches and chunk_size are positive integers. Events are (phase, stage, microbatch, start), with phase F/B and unit duration. All forward events finish before reverse-order backward events. x is (N,D), y (N,), w (D,); a short final chunk is allowed. Divide total squared error by N.

## Independent checks

T0 checks the callable contract and invalid boundaries. T1 uses hand calculations or an independent scalar formulation. T2 checks invariances, state conservation, gradients when meaningful, or atomic state changes. T3 invokes the supplied implementation in the deterministic experiment; it does not compare two imports of the same reference.

## Behavioral experiment

Train a four-feature linear model on 11 deterministic samples for 35 SGD steps at learning rate 0.08; compare full-batch and size-four chunks. Also compute useful-slot fractions for four stages as microbatch count varies.

A CPU model of equal-duration stages and synchronous updates, with linear regression; communication, BatchNorm and rematerialization are outside this kernel.
